title: remove dead from_static_str in response.rs
description: Response::from_static_str is a pub method with zero callers anywhere in the workspace. It was designed to convert the &'static str from authinfo_response() in auth.rs, but the session lifecycle uses Response::authentication_accepted() and Response::authentication_failed() directly instead. Dead code creates a misleading pattern: a contributor who finds from_static_str + authinfo_response might think that is the correct way to return auth responses and file a PR using them, introducing incorrect audit logging or missing it entirely.
